name: Flamethrower
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.

name: Fire Blast
description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of fire.

name: Hydro Pump
description: Blasts water at high power to strike the target.

name: Surf
description: Surfs across the battlefield to attack.

name: Solar Beam
description: Absorbs light in one turn and attacks on the next.

name: Vine Whip
description: Strikes the target with whip-like vines.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric blast that may paralyze.

name: Thunder
description: A wicked thunderbolt strikes the target.

name: Psychic

name: Shadow Ball
description: Hurls a shadowy blob to damage the target.

description: Slashes the target with sharp claws.

name: Dragon Pulse

name: Earthquake

name: Stone Edge
description: Sharp edged stones strike the target.

name: Aura Sphere
description: A vacuum wave that never misses.

name: Close Combat
description: A reckless full-body close combat attack.

name: Ice Beam
description: Freezes the target with a beam of ice.

name: Blizzard
description: A howling blizzard attacks the target.

name: Crunch

name: Moonblast
